'''Lightning Strike''' is a [[melee]] [[strike]] [[attack]] [[active skill|skill]] that converts physical damage to [[lightning damage]]. It has a secondary effect where it launches [[projectiles]] that deal damage based on the player character's weapon damage with each swing.

==Skill functions and interactions==
An attack with Lightning Strike consists of two parts:
* An initial melee hit with the gem tags [[Lightning]], [[Attack]], [[Melee]], [[Strike]]
* A projectile attack with the gem tags  [[Lightning]], [[Attack]], [[Projectile]]

When the melee attack is made, a default of three lightning projectiles will shoot out in a ~85 degree arc, traveling in a straight line until they strike an enemy. Projectiles will do full weapon damage, of which 50% of physical damage is converted to lightning damage (the bolts benefit from added damage, e.g. as from aura's), against any target struck. Projectiles created by a melee strike that hit an enemy do not immediately hit that enemy (though one could through [[return]]). Linking a {{il|Lesser Multiple Projectiles}} or {{il|Greater Multiple Projectiles}} support gem will multiplicatively reduce the damage of each projectile and spread further projectiles out within the 85 degree arc.

''Cannot Miss:'' This applies only to the projectiles launched after you initiated the strike. Swinging in enemies' general direction will result in projectiles with a hit/miss chance equal to that of the skill itself. Projectiles that miss will be dissipated without doing damage.

[[Damage conversion]]: Like all converted damage, the lightning portion of Lightning Strike's damage will be modified by both lightning damage and physical damage increases. Furthermore, the damage done by the lightning bolts is considered projectile damage (instead of melee), therefore any Strength bonus does not apply.

It is important to note that despite the confusing wording of this skill, the projectile portion of this attack in no way scales off the melee portion of the attack - in essence, the Lightning Strike skill does two completely separate things simultaneously, a melee attack (which deals x% of the base damage, and of which 50% of the physical damage is converted to lightning damage), and a ranged attack (which shoots projectiles dealing full weapon damage, and of which 50% of the physical damage is converted to lightning damage). 

This means that increasing the melee portion of the hit through melee-exclusive means such as {{il|Melee Physical Damage}} will not actually increase the projectile damage; the projectile damage is not "converted melee damage", a common misconception. Do not be deceived by the tooltip DPS of this skill which will change if you apply a melee-exclusive modifier; the tooltip DPS only shows the DPS of the melee portion of the attack and things that modify that, but not the projectile part of the attack. 

That said, passive points that grant ''Increased damage with one-handed melee weapons'' for example will in fact affect the projectile attack as well if one is using a one-handed weapon, since it is still an attack that is dealt with a '''melee weapon''' (though the damage you're dealing is not actually ''melee'' damage). However, ''Increased melee damage with one-handed weapons'' would only apply to the melee portion of the attack, as it increases '''melee damage'''.

Any flat elemental damage gains from gear, auras, weapons or any other source will apply to both the projectile and the melee portion of the attack.

* '''[[Dual Wielding]]''': Dual wielding attacks with Lightning Strike will alternate the weapon being swung.

* '''[[Gain on hit|Life on Hit]]''': The stated amount of life on hit will be restored for the initial hit and each time a projectile strikes an enemy.

* '''[[Pierce|Piercing Projectiles]]''': Lightning Strike projectiles which pierce an enemy and strike another will do the usual projectile damage to all enemies struck.

* '''[[Point Blank]]''': Projectiles are affected by Point Blank even though the melee attack is not.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/11707/filter-account-type/staff/page/10#p735869|author=Mark_GGG|title=Mechanics Thread|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|date=December 3, 2012|accessdate=October 21, 2013}}</ref>

* '''[[Iron Grip]]''': Taking iron grip will apply Strength damage bonus to projectile portion of attack. Without iron grip only the melee portion of attack receives damage bonus from [[Strength]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/11707/filter-account-type/staff/page/10#p735869|author=Mark_GGG|title=Mechanics Thread|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|date=December 4, 2012|accessdate=December 29, 2015}}</ref>

* '''[[Reflect]]''':  Reflected attack damage (whether physical or elemental) can be evaded, blocked and dodged.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/11707/filter-account-type/staff/page/10#p735869|author=Mark_GGG|title=Mechanics Thread|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|date=December 4, 2012|accessdate=December 29, 2015}}</ref>

* '''[[Chain]]''':  Projectiles can chain (for example if linked with {{il|Chain Support}}), however they won't chain if they pierce.

* The modifier {{c|mod|x% of Physical Damage added as}} from things like [[Hatred]] and [[Added Fire Damage]] is based on physical damage '''before''' conversions. So it will be based on the full base damage, not just the 50% physical part. This applies to both - melee damage and projectile damage.

* '''[[Ancestral Call Support]]''': If there are additional targets within range, Ancestral Call will target and attempt to strike additional enemies; these strikes will release projectiles in the direction of the target struck. Without additional targets, Lightning Strike will not swing aside from the main strike and thus not produce extra projectiles. However, against single targets, you can benefit from additional strikes from Ancestral Call Support and other similar bonuses by attacking outside melee range. This will create two lightning strikes, one from Ancestral Call which hits the target, and one from your own attack which will fire projectiles that can also hit the target. Example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxiBvBzunj8

* '''{{il|Behead Support}}''': Lightning Strike can be linked with Behead Support. Both the melee strike and projectile portions of Lightning Strike can grant the Behead buff on killing blow as well as refresh the buff on hit.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.26.0|
* Lightning Strike: Projectiles now deal 50% less Damage with Hits and Ailments.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* No longer has Added Lightning Damage at all gem levels.
* It now has 198% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 135%), scaling up to 456% at gem level 20 (previously 225%).
* Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1, scaling up to 10 at gem level 20 (previously 6 at all gem levels)
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now causes the skill to Fire +0-1 Projectile, instead of providing 0-20% increased Projectile Speed.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.20.0|
* Lightning Strike now Fires 2 additional Projectiles at all gem levels (previously 4 at gem level 1, up to 7 at gem level 20). Quality on Lightning Strike no longer provides 0-20% increased Damage.
* Quality on Divergent Lightning Strike no longer provides "Fire 0-2 additional Projectiles." Instead, it now provides 0-20% chance to Shock enemies.
* Labyrinth Helmet Enchantments that cause Lightning Strike to fire additional Projectiles now have values of 1 and 2 (previously 2 and 3).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.19.0g|
